project:Project.description: Business Motivation Model (BMM) profile includes set of concepts that define the elements of business plans.

mdElement.text:
Use this diagram to define Business Data (vocabulary):

  • Business Data helps to understand business domain.
  • Business Data definition allows for using the same concepts in a whole project.
  • Business Data can be represented as Data Objects in BPMN Process diagrams.
  • Create BPMN Business Data Description Table to provide a textual business data description.

Use this diagram to define business processes descriptions:

  • Group BPMN Processes into packages to organize the processes according to a selected criteria.
  • Draw relations between the BPMN Processes.
  • Create BPMN Processes Description Table to provide textual process description.
  • Create BPMN Process Diagram to represent the process flow.

Use this diagram to define organization structure and posts (roles in organization):

  • Organization Elements can be represented as Pools in BPMN diagrams.
  • Post and Person can be assigned as Resources to Activities in BPMN Process Diagram.
  • Create BPMN Resource Roles Description Table to provide textual organization structure description.
